parts.text: Martha is knitting winter wear for her 3 grandchildren.
They're triplets, so they're all the same size.
She wants to make a hat, scarf, sweater, mittens, and socks for each of them.
It takes 2 skeins of wool to make a hat, 4 for a scarf, 12 for a sweater, 1 for a pair of mittens, and 2 for a pair of socks.
Martha also has a cat that loves to play with the wool.
The cat uses 5 skeins of wool per day to play, but Martha always takes them back at the end of the day, so they don't affect the total amount of wool she needs.
How many skeins of wool will Martha need to buy?

parts.text: Heather bought a jumbo bag of raisins with 36 cups of raisins in it.
She wants to make oatmeal cookies, granola, and snack mix with the raisins.
A batch of oatmeal cookies takes 2/3 of a cup of raisins.
How many batches of oatmeal cookies can Heather make if she divides the bag of raisins equally among the cookies, granola, and snack mix?
